messages:
jordan (prod-eng): morning async — rolling canary for feature_flag=llm_kv_cache to 10% worldwide. starting at 3% an hour ago.
maya (release-eng): saw the deploy-bot kicked it off, thanks. can we keep EU slices at 5% until we validate latency?
sam (sre): FYI p95 tokens/sec in eu-west-1 jumped ~220ms over baseline right after canary increase. digging into host metrics now.
jordan (prod-eng): ack. i'm looking at batch sizing + kernel switch in the new build. might be related to seq_len distribution change in incoming requests.
karen (pm): any customer-facing impact? support hasn't flagged anything yet.
sam (sre): no PagerDuty alerts so far, but internal SLO noise on the dashboard. tagging ops-oncall for visibility.
ops-oncall: on it — will hold traffic shift if you ask.
maya (release-eng): please pause further ramp to 10%. keep at 5% until we validate EU.
jordan (prod-eng): pausing ramp. can someone post the exact query to flip the flag back if we need immediate rollback?
maya (release-eng): curl -X POST https://console.reddemo.internal/flags/llm_kv_cache/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" -d '{"percentage":5}' 
(also available in the runbook)
sam (sre): investigating pod-level metrics — suspect one host with a bad kernel fallback causing higher latency. isolating now.
jordan (prod-eng): good catch. i'm starting a quick canary-only rollback plan if we confirm kernel mismatch.
deploy-bot: rollout started for llm_kv_cache -> 3% -> 5% (initiator: jordan).
karen (pm): thanks team. next steps: 1) confirm EU host isolation by 10:15, 2) hold global ramp, 3) update support if anything customer-impacting appears.
ops-oncall: isolated host i-0abc123 in eu-west-1, cordoned and drained; p95 trending back down to baseline.
sam (sre): baseline restored on eu-west-1 after drain, p95 back to normal. no errors in model-serving logs.
maya (release-eng): keeping canary at 5% for another 30m for observation. thumbs if you agree. :thumbsup:
jordan (prod-eng): :thumbsup: will prepare a rollback PR and a postmortem checklist in case we need it.
karen (pm): i'll notify product stakeholders of the pause and ETA for re-eval.
ops-oncall: leaving a note in the incident channel for visibility.
maya (release-eng): re-open this thread with metrics snapshot after 30m and decide on ramp/no-ramp.
jordan (prod-eng): will do — uploading perf graphs to the thread in 20m.
notes: async standup + cross-team canary check-in; short updates and actions
